name: College of Alameda Concurrent Enrollment for High School Students
what_you_do: You take real college classes while you are still in high school.
who_can_apply: High school students. You need a principal's recommendation, a parent's consent and approval from the college. The program page does not name a grade or age limit.
pay_detail: Tuition and fees are free for up to 15 units of approved classes each semester. Books and travel costs are not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: The program page lists no deadlines or term dates.
how_to_apply: Talk to your high school counselor and pick a class. Apply to a Peralta college online. Fill out the high school special enrollment form, signed by a parent and your counselor. Bring your transcript and a photo ID to Admissions and Records. Meet a college counselor, then sign up for classes.
notes: Most students may take up to 11 units in fall and spring and 9 units in summer. The page lists higher limits for CCAP dual enrollment, which has its own agreement. Dual enrollment does not replace a course your high school offers. College of Alameda phone: 510-522-7221.
